chunks: Yahya al-Halabi, from al-Muthanna, from Abu Baseer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the statement of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic
As if their faces were covered with pieces of the dark night
He said: Do you not see the house? When it is night, it is darker inside than outside. Therefore, they increase in darkness.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Quranic verse 'as if their faces were covered with pieces of the dark night'?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) elucidates Surah Yunus 10:27 by employing a tangible analogy: just as a house appears darker within than without during the night, the spiritual obscurity of disbelievers intensifies internally. This interpretation, recorded in *Al-Kafi*, highlights the progressive deepening of their inner blindness as a direct consequence of their rejection of divine truth.
